title: Signal: Private key material served in a response
scope: One response whose body contains a PEM private-key block.
limitations: One response body. The rule reports the PEM markers and payload shape; it does not validate the key and cannot tell which service the key belongs to.

observation.body:

fpNotes: A documentation page that quotes the BEGIN marker without a key body is not reported, because the base64 payload is required as well.
